scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Create the GUI
local MainFrame = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
MainFrame.Name = "ScriptBloxGUI"
MainFrame.Parent = game.CoreGui

local NoclipButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
NoclipButton.Name = "Noclip"
NoclipButton.Parent = MainFrame
NoclipButton.Text = "Noclip"
NoclipButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.1, 0)
NoclipButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.1, 0)

local FlingButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
FlingButton.Name = "Fling"
FlingButton.Parent = MainFrame
FlingButton.Text = "Fling"
FlingButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.2, 0)
FlingButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.1, 0)

local BringButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
BringButton.Name = "Bring"
BringButton.Parent = MainFrame
BringButton.Text = "Bring"
BringButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.3, 0)
BringButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.1, 0)

local InvincibilityButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
InvincibilityButton.Name = "Invincibility"
InvincibilityButton.Parent = MainFrame
InvincibilityButton.Text = "Invincibility"
InvincibilityButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.4, 0)
InvincibilityButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.1, 0)

-- Noclip Toggle
local noclipEnabled = false
NoclipButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  noclipEnabled = not noclipEnabled
  if noclipEnabled then
    NoclipButton.Text = "Noclip (On)"
    LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.PlatformStand = true
  else
    NoclipButton.Text = "Noclip"
    LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.PlatformStand = false
  end
end)

-- Fling Others
FlingButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
  local target = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(game.Workspace:FindFirstChildFromMouse(mouse))
  if target and target ~= LocalPlayer then
    local direction = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Velocity = direction * **50**
  end
end)

-- Bring Parts
BringButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
  local target = game.Workspace:FindFirstChildFromMouse(mouse)
  if target then
    local direction = target.Position - LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
    target.Velocity = -direction * **10**
  end
end)

-- Invincibility
local invincibilityEnabled = false
InvincibilityButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
  invincibilityEnabled = not invincibilityEnabled
  if invincibilityEnabled then
    InvincibilityButton.Text = "Invincibility (On)"
    LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.MaxHealth
    LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
      LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.MaxHealth
    end)
  else
    InvincibilityButton.Text = "Invincibility"
  end
end)
